title: The note under the door
summary: Somebody in Pedro's building complains about his music, and he decides to reply in an unusual way.
paragraphs: One morning, Pedro found a note under his door. It was written in neat capital letters: "TO THE PERSON IN 2B. YOUR MUSIC IS TOO LOUD AT NIGHT. SOME OF US WORK EARLY. PLEASE BE {{CONSIDERATE}}." There was no name. Pedro read it twice and felt both embarrassed and annoyed. He played the piano, but only until ten o'clock. Was that really too late?

He wanted to write an angry reply. Instead, he made a cup of coffee and thought about it. The note said "some of us work early". He didn't know who lived around him. In two years, he had never spoken to his neighbours except to say good morning in the lift.

So Pedro wrote a different kind of note. He put it on the board by the mailboxes: "Hello from 2B. I'm sorry my piano is disturbing someone. I didn't know. Could you tell me which hours are a problem? Or knock on my door, and we can talk. Pedro." He added a drawing of a piano with a sad face, and felt a little {{silly}}.

Two days later there was a knock at his door. It was Mrs Herrero from 3B, a nurse who started work at six in the morning. She was a bit {{nervous}}. "I'm sorry about the note," she said. "I was very tired that night." Pedro invited her in. They agreed that he would stop playing at nine on weekdays, and that on Sundays, when she didn't work, he could play until ten.

Then something unexpected happened. Mrs Herrero saw his music books and said that she had played the piano as a girl, but had stopped thirty years ago. Now, every Sunday afternoon, she comes down to 2B for an hour. Pedro teaches her a little, and she brings cake. The note is still on his fridge. Under the capital letters, she has written in small blue letters: "SORRY. AND THANK YOU."

considerate.meaning: thinking about other people and their feelings

silly.meaning: a little stupid or not serious

questions.question: What did the first note complain about?
questions.explanation: The note said his music was too loud at night.

questions.question: Why did Pedro decide not to write an angry reply?
options: He realised he didn't know his neighbours or their situation.
He was afraid of the person.
questions.explanation: He thought about it and realised he had never spoken to his neighbours.

questions.question: What did Pedro and Mrs Herrero agree?
options: He would never play the piano again.
She would move to another flat.
He would stop at nine on weekdays and could play until ten on Sundays.
He would only play in the morning.
questions.explanation: He would stop at nine on weekdays, and on Sundays he could play until ten.

questions.question: What happens every Sunday now?
options: Pedro gives a concert in the building.
Mrs Herrero has a piano lesson with Pedro.
They write notes to the other neighbours.
questions.explanation: Every Sunday afternoon she comes to 2B, Pedro teaches her a little and she brings cake.
